thread:
mike: quick pitch  tiny launch experiment: 20-min "lightning" demo + benchmark one-pager + 48h drip. goal: improve first-api-call rate by 10% for new signups. offer: 500 sign-up tokens + 500 attendee bonus.

hana: short and sharp 8. timeline?

mike: live Thurs 10am PT. creative + landing by Tue. dev / tracking by Wed.

lina: landing UX: auto-credit 500 at signup, attendee modal to claim bonus. want a CTA button "Run starter prompt" inside claim modal. reduces friction.

devon: noted. will add cohort param and canary flag. snippet for landing devs: `?utm_source={{channel}}&utm_medium={{medium}}&utm_campaign=lightning_launch_0602&cohort={{cohort}}&canary={{canary}}`

hana: subject line A/B: A) "Try Redwood Inference: 1,000 free tokens" B) "Ship LLM features faster  with starter prompts". split 50/50.

mike: also want a short benchmark narrative doc to post after demo: baseline latency/cost numbers + sample prompts + expected unit economics if teams use batching/kv cache. helps sales and community shareability.

lina: prompt pack: 4 starter prompts (summarize, refactor, extract entities, embedding search). will include runnable examples + code snippet for Python + JS.

devon: add tracking events: `lightning_registrant`, `lightning_attendee`, `lightning_credit_claim`, `first_api_call`. analytics-bot, pls expose a funnel tile.

analytics-bot: added events. dashboard tile `lightning_launch_funnel` queued.

mike: growth: small paid slice (2k) to Twitter devs + GitHub. organic: product hunt + newsletter. lina, we'll need 3 social variants: launch, 24h reminder, post-launch highlight with benchmark one-pager.

hana: compliance note: credit usage limited to hosted API . add copy on landing + claim modal.

lina: will add copy: "Credits for hosted API only. For Private deployments contact your AE."

devon: PR will land Wed AM: https://git.internal/redwood/marketing/lightning-launch-0602 (WIP). will include `cohort` + `canary` query params.

mike: canary plan: 15% audience variant B (subject + hero copy), 85% variant A. measure registrant->first-call lift.

lina: UX ask: include a tiny inline code snippet in the claim modal so user can copy-paste and run quickly. e.g.:
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="{{api_key}}")
print(c.generate("Summarize this...", max_tokens=100))
```

hana: timeline recap: copy + creative Tue EOD, landing Wed AM, growth seeds Wed PM, webinar Thu 10am. post-launch drip: recording + one-pager + prompt pack 1h after. 48h follow-up with "Try this now" CTA.

mike: metrics owner: hana (growth) + analytics for dashboard. canary review Fri.

ops-bot: preview URL: https://redwood-preview.app/lightning-launch-0602 (expires 48h).

devon: last note: ensure claim flow tracks utm fields on the `lightning_credit_claim` event so we can attribute by ad source.

analytics-bot: `lightning_credit_claim` will include utm_campaign, utm_source, cohort, canary, user_id. preview ok.

mike: perfect. thanks all, will schedule a 15-min go/no-go Tue afternoon. :sparkles:
